address: Sultan Street, As Salamah, Jeddah, 23437, Saudi Arabia
bio: This all-day eatery specialises in carefully prepared Middle Eastern and Saudi plates. Inside, the restaurant is simple yet with a warm and homely feel. The dishes are unique and well-flavoured, with Saudi ingredients at the forefront. Their mezze platters are made to share when you’re in a large group, and some noteworthy dishes are the Laban Setto and the sticky date pudding – all fairly priced.
